rows.ProposalDescription1:
Proposal based on plans by Kimley-Horn, sheets L0.51 thru L1.51 & L2.00 thru L2.51, dated 8-14-2026


LANDSCAPE NOTES: This bid reflects the plant schedule quantities shown on the plans. An add/deduct price can be provided for quantity discrepancies between the actual count and the plant schedule. Small material landscape pricing reflects container size where height and spread do not align with gallon size.  Mulch shall be Cocoa Brown per schedule. This proposal does not include drainage sump gravel, tree protection, topsoil, backfill, herbicide, root barrier, fertilizer, or soil remediation.



IRRIGATION NOTES: The location and type of water source identified on plans as 1" potable water meter. This design/estimate is based on 15 GPM @ 40 PSI using a 1” Potable meter. Any deviation may result in design/price changes. Cost of water source is not included in the estimate but can be provided if requested. Power to irrigation Timer/Controller to be provided by others. Juniper does not install backflow prevention, therefore; the irrigation price does not include the cost of a backflow. This should be installed by a certified plumber. Juniper Landscaping shall not be liable for the meters ability to produce the require volume of water required for the irrigation system to function as designed or the quality of water.
